fixtureData: Actual settings/history/lifecycle components, fictional local records, mocked notification permission/FCM APIs; no hosted database or provider calls

checks.test: Opening reminder settings never requests notification permission automatically
Preference save carries authenticated-account binding and overnight quiet-hour settings
Browser push requests permission only after an explicit enable action
Turning off attendance push revokes the device registration
Shared reminder history marks a message read and opens an authenticated app screen
Browser permission denial does not create a registered device
A build without Firebase remains honest and never requests permission or an FCM token
Configured Android flow registers its native token after explicit permission
An account mismatch hides stale preferences and prevents editing another account
A failed history query is shown as an error instead of an empty inbox
Branch timing can be saved without falsely claiming the worker or FCM is configured
Stale branch changes keep the editor open and report the conflict
